PA1.note: TOST-style: equivalence only if the whole 95% CI of index_SL - index_EN lies in [-8, +8].

decomposition.note: b3_* are the fractions of total removal energy in the four 12-layer bands, i.e. WHERE the edit sits; log_ncov/span/mean_depth are HOW MUCH depth it covers. The frozen PB1 base model already contains b3, so the coverage terms are tested on top of placement.

PB2.reading: PB2 predicted broad-and-weak BELOW narrow-and-strong in Slovene, i.e. (narrow - broad) > 0.

PB3.reading: PB3 predicted the (narrow - broad) contrast to be LARGER in Slovene than in English.
